# braintrust_group (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust group. Groups are collections of users that can be assigned permissions via ACLs. Groups can also inherit from other groups.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group. Must be unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the group.
- `member_groups` (List of String) IDs of groups this group inherits from. An inheriting group has all the users of its member groups.
- `member_users` (List of String) IDs of users in this group.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of group creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of group deletion, or null if the group is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the group (UUID).
- `org_id` (String) Organization the group belongs to.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the group.
